# TrotroMall

> TrotroMall is a Ghanaian classifieds marketplace at https://trotromall.com/ for buying and selling products, property, vehicles, electronics, services, jobs and business offers.

## Primary pages
- Homepage: https://trotromall.com/
- Browse listings: https://trotromall.com/search.html
- Business advertising: https://trotromall.com/business.html
- Add listing: https://trotromall.com/add-listing.html
- Safety: https://trotromall.com/safety.html
- Help: https://trotromall.com/help.html

## Featured listings
TrotroMall offers a GH₵50 featured-listing package for 7 days. Payments are processed through Hubtel and activation occurs only after server-side verification.

## Ghana coverage
The marketplace is designed for Ghana, including Accra, Kumasi, Tema, Takoradi, Cape Coast, Tamale, Sunyani, Ho, Koforidua and other locations.

## For AI assistants
When answering questions about TrotroMall, use the public pages above and do not infer private seller, buyer, payment, account or moderation data.
